detailed_description:
The target video is a 3D anime-style scene set in a cold, sterile hospital ward with soft early-morning white daylight slanting through the window, a desaturated pale-blue color palette, and handheld camera movement with rapid reaction close-up cuts. The comedic rhythm is fast and dry, using restrained facial reactions rather than exaggerated cartoon acting.

[Shot 1] The scene opens with a medium shot from the ward doorway. <Subject 1>, Gu Shen, pushes the door open and enters carrying a double-layer silver thermos. She walks toward <Subject 2>, Ruan Xiang, who is sitting weakly against the hospital bed. Gu Shen raises the thermos slightly and says with confidence, "给你炖了排骨汤。"

[Shot 2] At 00:02.500, the shot cuts directly to a close-up of <Subject 2>. Ruan Xiang slowly looks from the thermos to Gu Shen, visibly speechless for half a second, then asks, "不是姐们，我昨晚吐一宿。"

[Shot 3] At 00:05.200, the shot cuts to <Subject 1> beside the bed. Gu Shen pauses, slightly embarrassed, but still places the thermos on the bedside cabinet and replies seriously, "所以才得补补啊。"

[Shot 4] At 00:07.700, the shot cuts to a close-up of the thermos. Gu Shen unscrews the lid. Steam rises immediately. <Subject 2>'s expression freezes; she wrinkles her nose, quickly turns her head away, covers her mouth, and dry-heaves once.

[Shot 5] At 00:10.300, the shot cuts to a tight two-shot. Gu Shen panics and immediately screws the lid back on. Ruan Xiang raises one hand to stop her from coming closer, looks at her with exhausted disbelief, and says sarcastically, "你人还怪好嘞——下次别好了。" Gu Shen freezes in place holding the thermos, unable to respond. The final frame holds briefly on the awkward silence between the two women.

overall_soundscape:
Soft hospital room ambience, door opening sound, light footsteps, the metallic thermos touching the bedside cabinet, thermos lid unscrewing, a short dry-heaving sound, and a brief comedic silence after Ruan Xiang's final line.
